footprints.description: SOD-523 diode, Diodes Incorporated drawing, 1.2 x 0.8 mm body
footprints.note: Diodes Incorporated SOD523 suggested pad layout (R1), datasheets/diode/diodes/SDM03U40Q.pdf p.4: X 0.60, Y 0.70, G 0.80, X1 2.00 -> span 1.40; body E 1.20 mid (1.15-1.25) x D 0.80 mid (0.75-0.85). Pin 1 = cathode (band)

footprints.description: PowerSOD-323 (SOD-323P) diode, Diotec drawing, 1.9 x 1.25 mm body
footprints.note: Diotec minimum recommended solder pad sizes, Power SOD-323 (R1), datasheets/diode/diotec/5_solder-pads.pdf p.3 (https://diotec.com/files/diotec/files/pdf/products/generalinformation/5_solder-pads.pdf; the SRL23 datasheet prints the outline only): cathode pad 2.0 long x 1.1, anode pad 0.8 long x 1.0, centres 1.9 apart; unequal pads, so explicit; origin = centre of the land pattern's 3.3 extent (the drawing does not tie the pads to the body); body 1.9 x 1.25, srl23.pdf p.2. Pin 1 = cathode (the bigger terminal, band)

footprints.description: SOD-323F (SC-90) diode, Nexperia drawing, 1.7 x 1.25 mm body
footprints.note: Nexperia reflow soldering footprint for SC-90 (SOD323F), sod323f_fr (R1), datasheets/diode/nexperia/BAS16J.pdf p.5 (same on PMEG4005EJ.pdf p.5): solder lands 0.6 x 0.6, centres 2.2 apart; body 1.7 mid (1.6-1.8) x 1.25 mid (1.15-1.35). Pin 1 = cathode (band)

footprints.description: MiniMELF (SOD-80C) diode, Nexperia drawing, 3.5 x 1.53 mm body
footprints.note: Nexperia reflow soldering footprint SOD80C, sod080c (R1), datasheets/diode/nexperia/BZV55_SER.pdf p.9: solder lands 0.90 x 1.60, 2.30 between them -> centres 3.20; body 3.5 mid (3.3-3.7) x 1.525 mid (1.45-1.60) diameter, p.8. Pin 1 = cathode (band)

footprints.description: SOD-123FL diode, Panjit drawing, 2.8 x 1.8 mm body
footprints.note: Panjit SOD-123FL mounting pad layout (R1), datasheets/diode/panjit/MBR1020VL.pdf p.3: pads 1.15 x 1.22, centres 3.10 apart (4.25 outer); body 2.80 mid (2.70-2.90) x 1.80 mid (1.70-1.90), p.1. Pin 1 = cathode (band)

footprints.description: SOD-123FL diode, Slkor drawing, 2.7 x 1.73 mm body
footprints.note: Slkor SOD-123FL outline, datasheets/diode/slkor/SM4007PLA7.pdf p.1: no land pattern, so R2 (flat leads): lead foot 0.5-1.1 -> pad length 1.90; lead width 0.6-1.0 -> pad width 1.05; 3.5-3.9 over the leads -> span 3.9 + 1.0 - 1.9 = 3.00; body 2.70 mid (2.5-2.9) x 1.725 mid (1.55-1.90). Pin 1 = cathode (band)
